ops.text: 14. Intellectual Property; Customer Data. (a) As between the Parties, Customer owns and retains all right, title and interest, including all intellectual property rights, in and to the Content, the Properties and all other data provided by, or collected on behalf of, Customer in connection with the Services (collectively, "Customer Data"). (b) As between the Parties, Kubient retains all right, title and interest in and to its pre-existing intellectual property, including the Auction Platform. (c) Customer shall own all deliverables and all work product created for Customer under this Agreement or any Exhibit, and Kubient hereby assigns all such deliverables and all such work product to Customer; Kubient grants Customer a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free licence to any Kubient intellectual property embedded in the deliverables. (d) Nothing in this Agreement creates any joint ownership of intellectual property.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement has no ownership provision, so we have added a short one: AP retains all rights in its Content, Properties and other data, Kubient retains its pre-existing IP including the Auction Platform, AP owns and is assigned the deliverables and work product it pays for with a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free licence to any Kubient IP embedded in them, and there is no joint ownership. This is our standard position that we own what we contribute and what we pay for.
